This option denotes percentage of clock period which is used for clock shifting delay. By
default, 10% delay is applied.
%simv -sdc=clockglitch:<N> <vcs options>
For -simv=clockglitch:10 <vcs options> , delay of 10% of the period is applied.
-sdc=sanity:clock:noexit
Although the SDC analysis terminates for paths with identified Clock period violation, with
this option SDC checks continues for other clocks with no clock period violation
%simv -sdc=sanity:clock:noexit <vcs options>
At the point of encountering a clock period violation, all SDC checks are disabled.
Adding the following options overrides this behavior and continues the SDC checks. use
-sdc=sanity:clock:noexit to continue checks for other clocks.
-sdc=verify_reset:off
This option stops all the reset verification checks. All other runtime SDC checks proceed
as normal.
%simv -sdc=verify_reset:off <vcs options>
-sdc=dynamicfrequency
Without this option, all delay calculations are computed in the compile time and are
supposed to be the same even if the clocks related to these calculations are running
with a different clock period than what is specified in the SDC files. Any change in clock

period beyond the specified clock-margin would terminate the analysis for that clock. For
additional messages, this switch can be augmented with "diag" and "hi" options and can
be used as either -sdc=dynamicfrequency:diag or -sdc=dynamicfrequency:diag:hi.
Since clock periods are learnt dynamically, when this feature is enabled the clock-margin
grace argument (-sdc=sanity:clock:margin:n) is ignored.
%simv -sdc=dynamicfrequency <vcs options>
Sample messages relating to observed clock period change when dynamicfrequency
option is used during runtime:
SDC-WARN @ time 133 s : Clock period violation (due to change in
clock period) has been identified. All further SDC analysis related
to this clock: sys_clk except sanity:clock will be stopped.

SDC-LOG @ time 133 s : Clock period updated for clock:
testbench.mult.clk(sys_clk) (File:dynfreq_fs.sdc, Line:1) from 20 s
to 22 s

SDC-WARN @ time 155 s : Clock period within limits (due to clock
period stabilization). SDC analysis related to clock: sys_clk
started.
-sdc=maxSuccessiveViolations:<N>
This option enables the reporting of Early Capture violations on the destination for the
same transition in input on successive N or S -1 clock cycles, whichever is smaller.
Here is N any number higher than 1, and S is the setup multiplier specified in the
set_multicycle_path command.
By default, the reporting count is limited to 1 for a given input transition that
causes a change in the destination within the violation window. This reporting
count can be increased using by setting N to any number higher than 1 in
-sdc=maxSuccessiveViolations:<N>.
%simv -sdc=maxSuccessiveViolations:<N> <vcs options>
set_multicycle_path -setup 5 -from ff1* -to ff2*

Here, by default, only single violation is reported for a given change in ff1 that causes ff2
to change within 5 cycles. However, if -sdc=maxSuccessiveViolations:10 is used, then
Early Capture violations would be reported on consecutive cycles for 4 cycles for a given
change in ff1.
sanity:clock:noflop
Ensures that a sanity clock check is not performed by default, if this clock is not associated
with any flip-flops . You must mark this argument as true to conduct sanity clock checks
on clocks that have not experienced any flip-flops. The default of this clock is FALSE.
%simv -sdc=sanity:clock:noflop <vcs options>
sanity:clock:higherfreq
Reports clock sanity errors only when the runtime detected clock frequency is higher
than the compile time SDC defined clock frequency. If the frequency is higher, the margin
calculations are done after this check. The default of this clock is OFF .
%simv -sdc=sanity:clock:higherfreq <vcs options>
sanity:clock:period:nosdcoff
Ensures that after a few errors the SDC checks are disabled by default. Do not stop the
SDC checks just because period errors occur. The default of this clock is OFF.
%simv -sdc=sanity:clock:period:nosdcoff <vcs options>
sanity:clock:off
Ensures that sanity clock check is not required. Dynamic and regular clock sanity is
disabled in RT.

%simv -sdc=sanity:clock:off <vcs options>
sanity:clock:stabilizecount
Whenever a clocks period changes in simulation the number of cycles of the clock period
is used to stabilize the new clock, during this time no SDC analysis is performed. The new
period is accepted only after this duration if the period is stable.
%simv -sdc=sanity:clock:stabilizecount <vcs options>
dynamicfrequency:verbose
Enables the printing of period updates as well as delay value recalculation prints.
%simv -sdc=dynamicfrequency:verbose <vcs options>
-sdc=coverage:cmt
This option enables the comments from Synopsys Design Constraints (SDC) commands
to be included in the exclusion file together with the coverage report for all SDC levels.
This allows you to quickly and effectively locate commands in the exclusion file.
%simv -sdc=coverage:cmt <vcs options>
Figure 2 SDC Command with Comments

Figure 3 Exclusion File Generated with Comments
Figure 4 Coverage Report with Comments

evels.
This allows you to quickly and effectively locate commands in the exclusion file.
%simv -sdc=coverage:cmt <vcs options>
Figure 2 SDC Command with Comments

Figure 3 Exclusion File Generated with Comments
Figure 4 Coverage Report with Comments
-sdc=noprint_violation:<tag>
During simulation time, this option suppresses EARLY CAPTURE violation messages for
particular SDC kinds. Specify the SDC command type as an argument to this option.
-sdc=noprint_violation:mcp: Stops EARLY CAPTURE violation for the
set_multicycle_path commands.
-sdc=noprint_violation:fp: Stops EARLY CAPTURE violation for the
set_false_path commands.
-sdc=noprint_violation:cg: Stops EARLY CAPTURE violation for the
set_clock_group commands.
-sdc=noprint_violation:max_del: Stops EARLY CAPTURE violation for
set_max_delay commands.

-sdc=noprint_violation: This stops all EARLY CAPTURE violation printing.
-sdc=sanity:clock:higherfreq
hen this option is enabled, CLOCK PERIOD mismatch violations at runtime are triggered
only if the actual clock period is less than the value defined in the SDC. That is, the clock
is running at a higher frequency than specified.
%simv -sdc=sanity:clock:higherfreq <vcs options>
-sdc=random_delay:uniform
This option enables random delay injection support for all the destination flop during SDC
validation. This ensures that random delays are inserted based on the path multiplier limit,
preventing masking of timing issues.
With uniform random delays, VCS-SDC can check a violation when the source changes
within the specified violation window and capture occurs on the destination side. It adjusts
the number of cycles for inserting x or bool values based on the maximum multiplier value
associated with the destination flop and remaining violation window.
%simv -sdc=random_delay:uniform <vcs options>
Consider the following compile time option:
% vcs -sdc=verify_false_path:N
Here, by default the value of N is 10.
In the following example, the FP constraint has "10" cycles of path multiplier limit and the
tool provides an equal weightage for 1,2,39 cycles (1->10-1) on the destination flip-flop.
Consider the following RTL:
//FP source flop
dff S2 (in, clk2, rst, ff3);
//FP destination flop
dff D2 (ff3, clk2, rst, ff4);

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst)
if(!rst) q <= 0;
else q <= d;
Figure 5 False Path from S2 to D2
In the false path from S2 to D2, X- insertion occurs between 0 to 9 cycles randomly. At
runtime, during early capture event for a destination, the tool injects X for a specified
number of clock cycles (N). Let the remaining violation window for destination be W. This
number N is decided randomly between 0 to minimum of (M-1 and W). Here, M is the
maximum multiplier value associated with the destination. The probability of selection of a
number between 0 to minimum of (M-1 and W) is equal.

UNR Options
-unr=config.txt This switch invokes UNR flow which uses VC Formal Coverage
Analyzer under the hood to find unreachable coverage targets in
the design.
-unr=config.txt
This switch invokes UNR flow which uses VC Formal Coverage Analyzer under the hood
to find unreachable coverage targets in the design and saves them in an exclusion file
which can then be read with simulation coverage database to generate the final coverage
score. The configuration file sent with this switch helps to setup the Formal unreachability
analysis by providing the necessary options.
The following is the usage:
% vcs -cm line+cond+tgl+branch+fsm -unr=config.txt <other_options>
% vcs -cm line+cond+tgl+branch+fsm -unr=config.txt
For more details, refer to the Verification Continuum Guide to VCS Unreachability
Analysis.

Licensing Options
-licwait timeout Enables VCS to retry for a license until timeout expires, where
timeout is the time in minutes.
-licqueue /
+vcs+lic+wait
Tells VCS to try for the license till it finds the license.
VCS_LICENSE_WAIT You must set the VCS_LICENSE_WAIT variable to 1 and use the
-licqueue option, which enables the license queuing.
-licwait timeout
Enables license queuing, where timeout is the time in minutes that VCS waits for a
license before finally exiting.
% vcs -licwait timeout
% vcs -licwait 10 <other compile options>
Here, VCS waits for the license for 10 minutes.

Chapter 26: Licensing Options
-licqueue /+vcs+lic+wait
Tells VCS to try for the license till it finds the license. If there are multiple jobs asking for a
license, then any one of those jobs get the license (similar to the older or the deprecated
option +vcs+lic+wait).
% vcs -licqueue <other compile options> or % vcs +vcs+lic+wait
VCS_LICENSE_WAIT
You must set the VCS_LICENSE_WAIT variable to 1 and use the -licqueue option, which
enables the license queuing. Thus, the first job to enter the queue gets the license when
the license is available. This option must be used along with the -licqueue option.
% vcs VCS_LICENSE_WAIT
-licwait timeout Enables license queuing, where timeout is the time in minutes that
VCS waits for a license before finally exiting.
-licqueue /
+vcs+lic+wait
Tells VCS to wait for a network license if none is available.
VCS_LICENSE_WAIT You must set the VCS_LICENSE_WAIT variable to 1 and use the
-licqueue option, which enables the license queuing.
-licwait timeout
Enables license queuing, where timeout is the time in minutes that VCS waits for a
license before finally exiting.

Chapter 26: Licensing Options
% simv -licwait timeout
-licqueue / +vcs+lic+wait
Tells VCS to try for the license till it finds the license. If there are multiple jobs asking for a
license, then any one of those jobs get the license (similar to the older or the deprecated
option +vcs+lic+wait).
% simv -licqueue or % simv +vcs+lic+wait
VCS_LICENSE_WAIT
You must set the VCS_LICENSE_WAIT variable to 1 and use the -licqueue option, which
enables the license queuing. Thus, the first job to enter the queue gets the license when
the license is available. This option must be used along with the -licqueue option.
setenv VCS_LICENSE_WAIT 1
simv -licqueue <simv options>

RACE Options
-race Enables dynamic race detection (read-write races, write-write
races) for the entire design.
-racecd Enables race detection for the part of your design that is enclosed
between the ‘race and ‘endrace compiler directives.
+race=all Enables the static race detection tool.
-hsopt=racedetect Enables detection of clock-data races during simulation.
-race

% vcs test.v -race

Chapter 27: RACE Options

Enables race detection for the part of your design that is enclosed between the 'race and

Enables the static race detection tool. This option supports only pure Verilog constructs.

Preface
This document describes all the Error, Warning, and Note messages that are associated
with the VCS tool. The preface discusses the following:
• Customer Support
• Synopsys Statement on Inclusivity and Diversity
Customer Support
Customer support is available through SolvNetPlus.
Accessing SolvNetPlus
The SolvNetPlus site includes a knowledge base of technical articles and answers to
frequently asked questions about Synopsys tools. The SolvNetPlus site also gives you
access to a wide range of Synopsys online services including software downloads,
documentation, and technical support.
To access the SolvNetPlus site, go to the following address:
https://solvnetplus.synopsys.com
If prompted, enter your user name and password. If you do not have a Synopsys user
name and password, follow the instructions to sign up for an account.
If you need help using the SolvNetPlus site, click REGISTRATION HELP in the top-right
menu bar.
Contacting Customer Support
To contact Customer Support, go to https://solvnetplus.synopsys.com.
Synopsys Statement on Inclusivity and Diversity
Synopsys is committed to creating an inclusive environment where every employee,
customer, and partner feels welcomed. We are reviewing and removing exclusionary
language from our products and supporting customer-facing collateral. Our effort also
includes internal initiatives to remove biased language from our engineering and working
environment, including terms that are embedded in our software and IPs. At the same
time, we are working to ensure that our web content and software applications are usable
to people of varying abilities. You may still find examples of non-inclusive language in our

software or documentation as our IPs implement industry-standard specifications that are
currently under review to remove exclusionary language.

MSV-RTVS-XMR-TID
Cannot replicate RTVS xmr in digital instance hierarchy
The XMR '%s' points to an object within the hierarchy of the RTVS Spice instance '%s'.
However, the object cannot be located in the corresponding digital RTVS hierarchy due to
the absence of target node '%s' in module '%s'. When the RTVS XMR rewrite is enabled
and an XMR points to an object in the RTVS Spice hierarchy, it is required that the object
exist in the corresponding digital RTVS instance hierarchy.
To address this issue, rectify the XMR problem or disable the RTVS XMR rewrite feature.
You can disable RTVS XMR rewrite by removing '-adopt rtvs_xmr' from the VCS command
line or by adding the V2K attribute 'SNPS_NO_RTVS_XMR_REWRITE' to the relevant
statement or its enclosing scope.

legal flags are: %s.

should be %s.

The default behavior is to start coverage monitoring at time 0 and continue through the
end of simulation. Refer to the user guide for more information.

The %s option requires a string argument to specify the scope for coverage.

the covergroup and/or coverpoint/crosspoint names.

You have enabled code coverage and are using multiple configurations, but the parts

has a different architecture or entity binding %s and %s in the %s and %s configurations,
respectively.
Use the -cm_hier file to select the part of the hierarchy that is identical in all
configurations.

URG-FMM-CTDNP
Compile Time Data Not Provided
No compile-time data was found in any specified VDB directory, but compile-time data is
required for '%s'.
Ensure that at least one database contains compile time data.
URG-GCGNS
The %s grading option is not supported with path coverage.
You can use a different grading algorithm by omitting the '%s' suboption from the -grade
flag. Alternatively, you can use the %s option on just the supported metrics by using the
-metric <line+tgl+fsm+cond+branch> flag. For example, if your database has line,
cond, and path coverage, you can grade the line and condition the data by using only the
-metric line+cond flag.
URG-GIMX

The indexlimit grading option can only be used when index grading is selected first.
URG-GIRT
The rarethreshold grading option can only be used when score grading is selected first.
URG-GLF
Test load failed
You specified the '-grade' option to URG, but grading failed: %s.
The test may have been corrupted. Try regenerating it. If the problem still persists, contact
URG-GRCOL-LCA

title: Verification Continuum™
text:
The 'columns' grading feature in URG is a Limited Customer Availability (LCA) feature and
is not enabled by default.
You can enable use of the 'columns' flag by adding the '-lca' option on the URG command
line.
URG-GRSCI
Incompatible options
The -grade %s grading algorithm cannot be used with the scores grading suboption. The
scores suboption is supported only with index, greedy, and cost-based grading.
URG-GRTM
Conflicting limits
You specified a rare threshold of %s and an index limit of %s, but the index limit must be
greater than the rare threshold. Otherwise, every object is counted as rare.
Use an index limit greater than the rare threshold. If you do not specify an index limit, URG
automatically uses an index limit greater than the specified rare threshold.
URG-GRUR
Combination not supported

You specifed both the rarecounts and %s flags to urg -grade, but these options cannot be
used together.
URG-GSID-LCA
URG HVP '-group show_in_design' is a Limited Customer Availability (LCA) feature and is
not enabled by default.
Enable LCA by adding the '-lca' option to the URG command line.
URG-HCF-LCA
The HVP compressed feature in URG is a Limited Customer Availability (LCA) feature and
is not enabled by default.
You can enable use of the feature by adding the '-lca' option on the URG command line.

URG-HVP-CFO
Conflict options
The '%s' option is not supported with %s.
Use only one of them. Refer to the URG user guide for more information.
URG-IDF
Obsolete coverage database format
The coverage database found in '%s' is in the olddb format. This format is deprecated and
Regenerate the database in the newdb format.
URG-IOER
File I/O Error
Cannot %s the data file %s (Reason: %s).

title: Verification Continuum™
text:
Check for the write permission on the file or check the disk quota.
URG-LCA-FEATURE
URG option '%s' is a Limited Customer Availability (LCA) feature and is not enabled by
default.
Enable LCA by adding the '-lca' option to the URG command line.
URG-LTFF
Load test failed
A fatal error occurred while loading the test '%s', and URG has to exit.
URG-MIDR
Input database required
The merging mapped modules coverage requires the input database.

Specify both the base database and input database with the '-map' or '-mapfile' option.
URG-MINC
Incompatible algorithm
URG's -grade %s algorithm cannot be used on a merged test, but the test '%s' is the result
of merging with 'urg -dbname'.
URG-MO
Missing options
The '%s' option works with %s.
%s. Refer to the URG user guide for more information.
URG-MVOT
Multiple VDBs or Tests

title: Verification Continuum™
text:
The '-modtreefile' option is supported only on a compiled VDB with a single test in it, or on
a merged VDB.
To report the coverage of multiple tests using the '-modtreefile' option, you need to merge
their VDBs.

Executable not found
The %s executable was not found in %s.
Check that your installation process was successful and that the install area has not been
URG-NO-COST
Tests do not have requested cost
Cost-based grading based on %s was selected, but none of the tests to be graded had %s
measured for them.
URG-NOC
Cannot combine VDBs

title: Verification Continuum™
text:
The VDB directories %s and %s cannot be combined with the -combine flag %s.
URG-NOCN
Wrong number of VDB specified
The -combine switch requires exactly two VDB directories to work, but you specified %s.
URG-NTFD
No test found for the base design
URG could not find any test associated with the base design directory '%s'. So the input
coverage data cannot be mapped.
Add test directories after the base design directory and try again.

Not yet implemented for NEWDB

text:

Either remove the option from URG command line or switch to the old coverage database
URG-PAR-ARG
URG Arguments for Parallel Mode
Argument '%s' is only used in URG parallel mode.
Add '-parallel' argument or run 'urg -parallel -help' for information.
URG-PAR-CFO
Conflict options
The options %s will cause conflict.
Use one of them or set correct value for these options.
URG-PAR-CMDLL
Command line too long

The command line specified is too long for urg -parallel mode (%s characters).
URG-PAR-ENV
Submit command failed
Failed to run the submit command '%s'. The %s environment is not configured properly.
Check your %s settings.
URG-PAR-ENVVCS
Environment variable required
The VCS_HOME or VERA_HOME environment variable is not set.
Set the environment variable then try again.
URG-PAR-FC
Farm System Check Error

URG parallel does a quick check of the designated farm system before starting. In this
case the check had still not finished after ten seconds.
If you believe nothing is wrong, you can use the '-nocheck' option to skip this check.
URG-PAR-FOE
Open file failed
The file '%s' could not be opened: %s.
URG-PAR-ICO
Incompatible options
Only one of the -lsf, -grid or <mfile> options can be specified for a single urg -parallel run.
Use only one of the above options and try again.
URG-PAR-ICP
Incompatible options

The option '%s' cannot be used together with '-parallel'.
Run 'urg -parallel -help' to see the complete list of options that are supported in parallel
mode.
URG-PAR-INT
No merged database
URG could not find the final merged database at %s.
This could be due to errors reported previously during the merge.
URG-PAR-INV
Invalid options
The option '%s' could only be specified with the '-lsf' or '-grid' option.
Run 'urg -parallel -help' for information.

URG-PAR-IOP
Invalid options
The option '%s' could only be specified with the '%s' option.
Run 'urg -parallel -help' for information.
URG-PAR-LSF
Unsupported combination of switches
The '%s' switch can only be used when the '%s' switch is given.
It is not supported in other modes.
URG-PAR-MSA
Missing argument
The '%s' switch requires a %ssubargument.

%s
URG-PAR-NAM
No available machine
None of the machines listed in the machine list file '%s' could be used.
Check that the machine names are given correctly and that you have permission to rsh to
them.
URG-PAR-PNV
Incorrect numeric argument
The '%s' option requires a non-negative numeric argument to specify the number of
seconds to wait between checking the LSF grid (or 0 to disable it) but you specified '%s'.
Use a valid value.
URG-PAR-RF
Parallel URG failed in the final step

While URG was able to merge the specified VDBs, an error occurred during the final step
while generating the %s.
A file named %s/urg_parallel_error.log has been generated that contains more
information about the failure.
URG-PAR-SCF
Command failure
URG encountered an error %s. The command '%s' %s
Contact vcs_support@synopsys.com for help understanding the error.
URG-PAR-SKF
Sub-job missing from LSF farm
The final merge job submitted to the LSF farm for urg -parallel never completed, and no
more jobs are running on the LSF farm.
URG-PAR-SUB
Sub job failure

An error has occurred in a sub-job started by the URG parallel merging feature.
Refer to the later mentioned log.
URG-PAR-VERSION
URG version not found
Cannot find URG version by running 'urg -id'.
Check your URG setup and try again.
URG-PAR-WR
Missing argument
Argument '%s' should be specified for the option '%s'.
Run 'urg -parallel -help' for information.

URG-PATH-LCA
The path coverage in URG is a Limited Customer Availability (LCA) feature and is not
enabled by default.
You can enable the path coverage by adding the -lca option on the URG command line.
You can disable it by explicitly listing all metrics except path coverage as an argument to
the -metric option.
URG-PERM
Cannot execute
The %s executable was found at %s but it is not executable.
Check the permissions.
URG-PFBF
Project File Bad Format

Unable to process project file: %s
URG-PFLE
Project File Load Error
Unable to load project file: %s
URG-PGR-LCA
The Plan-Grading feature in URG is a Limited Customer Availability (LCA) feature and is
not enabled by default.
You can enable use of the feature by adding the '-lca' option on the URG command line.
URG-RCE
Reset Coverage error
Option '-dbname' is mandatory with '-reset_coverage' option.

Provide the option '-dbname' followed by a database name to exercise '-reset_coverage'.
URG-TNVE
No entry
None of the -tests files contain any entry.
Ensure that the -tests files contain valid test entries separated by newline.
URG-UNVM
Test load failed
Grading cannot proceed: %s
This can happen if you try to grade tests.
URG-USM
UnSupported metric

The metric '%s' is not supported with the option %s.
Supported metrics are: %s. Run urg -help for information.
URG-UVP
Unsupported VDB Provided
The VDB provided cannot be used with -show_summary.
Create a merged vdb with -dbname and provide it with -show_summary.
URG-WAG
Invalid argument for option
The first item '%s' given to the -warn option is not recognized as a valid usage.
To suppress the list of warning IDs, use -warn no<ID>,,no<ID>. To suppress all
warnings, use -warn none. To suppress all warnings with a few exceptions, use -warn
none,<ID>,,<ID>.
URG-WAII
Invalid message ID

The %s ID '%s' given to the %s option is invalid.
Ensure that you are using the correct %s ID.
URG-WAMI
Missing message ID
The %s ID is missing after the keyword 'no'.
Add the %s ID you want to %s after the keyword 'no'.
URG-WANO
Missing keyword 'no'
The item '%s' you are trying to suppress does not begin with the keyword 'no'.
Add the keyword 'no' before the %s ID you want to suppress.

URG-WIU
Invalid option usage
The '%s' option does not allow the usage of suppressing a list of %s IDs and suppressing
all %ss (with a list of exceptions) at the same time.

One-hot state too large
State \"%s\" was specified for FSM \"%s\" in module \"%s\" (file %s, line %s) in the
-cm_fsmcfg file. It is taken to be a one-hot state because its name is given in square
brackets []. But its value is greater than that can be contained in a 64-bit signal, and
therefore cannot be a one-hot FSM state. Values this large cannot be one-hot states. This
FSM will not be monitored.

Illegal sub-option for -cm_fsm_limit

The -cm_fsm_limit allows you to specify a +-separated list of these suboptions to control
FSM extraction.
VCM-FSMPVRG
Parameter value used for FSM changed
The parameter \"%s\" was used to define a value range in the code for FSM \"%s\" in
an 'inside' expression, but that value is different in different instances of the module (%s
%s in instance %s vs. %s%s in others). Ranges are enabled for SystemVerilog by the
-cm_fsmopt rangestates option. This allows VCS to extract FSMs based on these
ranges, but if parameters are used for the endpoints of ranges and those parameter
values are overridden, incorrect or incomplete results may occur.
VCM-INCOPT
Incompatible Options
The %s and %s options cannot be used together as they are mutually exclusive.
VCM-IRIS-CIERR
IRIS Internal Error

An error has occurred because IRIS optimization was detected in the coverage flow, but
the -Xkeyopt=iris+coverage option was not explicitly specified at compile time. To
enable this optimization feature, use the -Xkeyopt=iris+coverage compile-time option.

CM-IGNTS
Ignoring test status.
The test status '%s' is not a valid pattern and it is ignored. The valid base status patterns
are \"pass\", \"fail\", \"assert\", \"warn\" and \"unknown\". A legal test status is either one
of the base status strings or a string that ends with one of the base status strings in
parentheses.
The string preceding the parentheses can be any string without the strings \":::\",
\"(\", or \")\". For example, these are valid status strings \"my test@(pass)\"\n
\"my_test::(warn)\"\n \"my_test(warn)\"\n \"fail\". But these are illegal status
strings \"my test :::(pass)\" - contains \":::\" \"my test(passed)\" -
\"passed\" is not a legal base status string \"(my test)(pass)\". The preceding string
contains \"(\", \")\" \"failed\" which is not a legal base status string.
CM-MISSARG
Missing subargument.

The '%s' flag requires a subargument.
Refer to Coverage documentation for more details.
CM-SAAM
Missing subargument.
The -cm_stats flag requires the \"none\" subargument.
Specify \"-cm_stats none\" to use this flag, which suppresses saving simulation-time
metrics to the coverage VDB directory.
CM-STVH
Flag has no effect.
The -cm_stats flag has no effect in pure VHDL mode because simulation run statistics
are not saved during pure VHDL simulation.

The -cm_dir option is not recommended in the genip stage.
Both the -genip and -cm_dir options are provided on the VCS command line. Providing
the same -cm_dir option in genip and integ phases can lead to some files in the VDB
being overwritten. It is advised to use the cm_dir option only in the integ phase which is
usually the last invocation of the VCS command.

The VDB '%s' being used as reference has multiple tests. The first test '%s' will be used as

VCM-FSMCFGSPR
Fsm state specification ambiguity
The state \"%s\" for FSM \"%s\" was automatically detected by VCS. But because
the -cm_fsmcfg flag was given and a list of states was specified with the STATES
directive for this FSM, only states specified in that list will be monitored for coverage. And
while state \"%s\" has the same default value (%s) as the state \"%s\" specified in the
configuration file, both states are parameters and their values depend on how the module

is instantiated. Therefore, because \"%s\" was not named in the -cm_fsmcfg file, neither it
nor any of its transitions will be monitored for FSM coverage.
If you intended for this state to be monitored, specify it by name in the STATES list in the
-cm_fsmcfg file, or use the BCID CM_FSMCFG_PARAM_STATES.

AST-MAXC
Number of hits on assertion exceeds limit

One or more assertions has a hit count that exceeds the maximum value supported in
reports. The affected assertions are shown in the report with a \"*\" character next to the
counts.
CCT_NRBIN_CHG
Non-random sample bin changed
The sampled bin of the non random coverpoint '%s' in covergroup '%s', which is part of
cross, has changed from '%s' to '%s'. This might lead to reduced effectiveness for cross
coverage hole targeting.
Check if the change in the bin of the non random coverpoint '%s' is intentional.
CG-MAXC
Number of hits on covergroup bin exceeds limit
One or more covergroup has a bin hit count that exceeds the maximum value supported in
reports. The affected covergroup bins are shown in the report with a \"*\" character next to
the counts.
CM-FSMPST
Parameter states with equal values merged

The FSM \"%s\" in module \"%s\" has two parameter states, \"%s\" and \"%s\", that have
the same value (%s) in instance \"%s\".
These two states are combined into a single state, reducing the number of states in the
FSM. The name \"%s\" is used for this value in coverage reporting. Any transitions to or
from state \"%s\" are reported as transitions for \"%s\" instead.

UCAPI-DIAG
UCAPI Diagnostic message
UCAPI Diagnostic Message for optimization : %s

UCAPI-HEX-BINNAME-OLDVDB
Hexadecimal bin names on old vdb requested
Generating hexadecimal bin names for user-defined array bins is not supported in older
VDBs.
UCAPI-INSMIS
Instance mismatch in input vdb
Instance '%s' in the input vdb '%s' is defined by module '%s', but it is defined by a different
module '%s' in the base vdb.
The instance in the input vdb is renamed to '%s' in the merged results.
UCAPI-MMSTU
Merge mode set to union
Default merging is not supported on union merged databases.
Continuing the merging in flex union mode.
UCAPI-NDI
No design information

The coverage databases loaded does not contain any design information, so the %s
relation from %s handle cannot be used.
UCAPI-NTCO
No Tests Covered Object
Specifying -trimtestrecords in the URG command line instructs URG to discard test
records for tests that are not included in any object's test correlation list.
UCAPI-OTRF
Only One Test Record Found
When there is only one test record in a VDB, the -trimtestrecords flag has no effect.
UCAPI-RCGLTCH
A Probable Coverage Glitch
Unreachable objects might have been covered due to a possible race condition in the
design. Compiling the design with -cm_glitch 0 might help to resolve it.

UCAPI-SLFT
Skipped Loading Failed Test
The coverage data from the '%s' test is not used, as its status is '%s' and the
-skip_failed_test option is used.
The test result status is set with the cm_post command or the $cm_post system call.
UCAPI-STTO
Show Tests Turned ON
-trimtestrecords is automatically turned on -show tests.
UCAPI-TRM-DIAG
Design Mismatch Reporting Enabled
The \"-diag tglmerge\" option is available along with the \"-flex_merge tgl\"
option to report mismatch between base and input designs.
UCAPI-TRM-DIAGREPEX
Mismatch Report Capacity Exceeded

Mismatch report exceeded its capacity. Therefore, Some portion of the report is truncated.
UCAPI-UMGUNS
Union merge of simulation vdb
You are attempting to union-merge data from '%s', which is a simulation-only vdb directory.
Union merge for code coverage is only supported for compiled or merged vdbs.
Coverage data from this vdb is merged with the default merge rule. Design data from '%s'
is used here.
UCAPI-UNINST
New module instance seen in input vdb
Instance name '%s' in the input vdb '%s' is not found in base design. Since union merging
is enabled it gets added to the merged result.
If you do not want to add regions from the input vdb, do not use the union merge option
on the URG command line.
UCAPI-UNIONADV
Exclusion of union member signal

Exclusion entry %s in exclusion file %s at line number %s is marked compile-time
excluded due to the usage of -cm_tgl union_adv option.
This signal cannot be excluded. if the -cm_tgl union_excl option has been used. The
tool automatically excludes corresponding bits of the top level union. You must review.
UCAPI-UNOBJ
New object seen in input vdb
%s, %s instance '%s' in the input vdb '%s' there is a '%s' at this location that does not exist
in the base vdb
Because union merge is specified, the objects are included in the merged vdb and the
generated report.
UCAPI-UNOBJGN
New generate iteration seen in input vdb
%s, %s instance '%s' in the input vdb '%s' there is a '%s' for a for-generate loop iteration
'%s' that does not exist in the base vdb. Because, union merge is specified, the objects
in this additional generate loop iteration is included in the merged vdb and the report is
generated.

UPF_GENERIC_HANDLE_NYI_PC
Unsupported ISO bind handles in Partcomp/PrecompiledIP.
Remove following handles from bind checkers UPF_GENERIC_SOURCE,
UPF_GENERIC_SINK and UPF_GENERIC_ISO_ELEMENT.
UPF_GENERIC_HANDLE_NYI_PC_DB
Unsupported bind handles for ISO DB cells in partcomp flow.
The handles UPF_GENERIC_SOURCE, UPF_GENERIC_SINK, and
UPF_GENERIC_ISO_ELEMENT are not supported for binding to ISO DB cells in partition
compile flow.
Remove these handles from bind checker command or remove the option
-power=applybindsonisodb.

Granular corruption not supported

title: Verification Continuum™
text:
Granular corruption is not supported on %s type element '%s' in module '%s'.
Provide bit-blasted elements or the complete element.
UPF_GRP_DEF
Group already defined
Group '%s' has already been defined at %s, %s.
To create a new Group, change the name of the Group.
UPF_GRP_INVALID_OBJ
Invalid object found
Invalid object '%s' specified in option '%s' of 'add_power_state'.
Specify predefined/user-defined [Supply Set | PST | Group | Domain].

UPF_GRP_INVALID_OPTION
Invalid option specified with group state
Invalid option '%s' specified with option '-group' for state '%s' of group '%s'.
Remove '-group' or '%s' from the command add_power_state.
UPF_GRP_INVALID_STATE
Invalid state reference found
State '%s' is not defined on object '%s' specified in 'add_power_state -logic_expr'.
Specify a predefined/user-defined state name.
UPF_GRP_MISSING_UPDATE
Missing '-update' option with group state
States are already defined for group '%s', option '-update' is missing.

Specify '-update' to add new state information to the group.
UPF_GRP_UNSUPPORTED_OPERATOR
Operators not yet supported
Unsupported syntax specified for group using 'add_power_state -logic_expr'.
Use only '==' in binary condition and '&&' to specify multiple conditions.
UPF_GRP_WRONG_UPDATE
Redundant '-update' option with group state
States are being defined for first time for group '%s', option '-update' is redundant.
Remove '-update' group states defined first time.
UPF_HUVSP
HDL2UPF VCT For Spice Port

HDL2UPF VCT '%s' specified with '%s' for spice port '%s'.
HDL2UPF Connections for spice supply ports are not supported. Remove the spice supply
port from the command.
UPF_IBCE
Invalid bind_checker element
Invalid element '%s' specified for scope '%s' in the bind_checker command. Element will
be ignored.
Specify a valid instance name.
UPF_IBCP
Invalid bind checker port
The port '%s' of checker module %s, as specified in the bind_checker command does not
exist.
Provide a proper port.
UPF_IBCPC
Invalid bind checker port connect

UPF name alias or concat expressions cannot be connected to the bind_checker port.
Provide a proper port connect.
UPF_IBCPO
Invalid bind checker parameter override
The parameter '%s' of checker module %s, as specified in the bind_checker command
does not exist.
Provide a proper parameter.
UPF_IBFSW
Invalid boolean function for switch
'%s' used in boolean function of '%s' option is not a control port of the power switch '%s'.
Any name in the boolean function must refer to a control port of the switch.

UPF_ICOPCF
Invalid command option in power config file
'%s' should not be specified in the power config file during compilation.
In order to specify %s during compile time, use command '%s' in the UPF file.
UPF_ICSTB
Instance cannot be set as terminal_boundary
Design attribute 'terminal_boundary' specified on '%s' is invalid as the design instance is at
DB cell '%s'(%s,%s). Cell library:%s.
UPF_ICSTBI
Instance cannot be set as terminal_boundary
Design attribute 'terminal_boundary' specified on '%s' is invalid as the design instance is
inside a DB instance. (Instance: '%s', Cell: '%s').

UPF_IDAS
Invalid design attribute specified
No other attribute can be specified in the same command along with attribute '%s'.
UPF_IETS
Invalid element type specified
The element '%s' specified in '%s' command is not a %s.
Specify valid element for the command.
UPF_IFNYI
Interval function not yet implemented
Use of interval function in expression is not yet supported.
UPF_ILFI_LDB
Invalid location for isolation

%s strategy '%s' is specified with location '%s'. Location 'parent/fanout' is not allowed
when 'lower_domain_boundary' feature is enabled.
UPF_IMIES
Invalid multiple iso enables/supplies
Isolation '%s' is defined with %s, but isolation model is not specified for multiple %s.
Use the map_isolation_cell UPF command to specify a model for mapping the
isolation.
UPF_IMNBC
Invalid module name in 'bind_checker'
Invalid module name '%s' specified with '%s' option in the 'bind_checker' command.
Specify a %s and recompile.

UPF_INA
Improper number of arguments
UPF command option '%s' is expected to have %s '%s' argument(s), but found '%s'
argument(s).
Pass the appropriate number of arguments and recompile.
UPF_INCOMPAT
VCS command option is not compatible with UPF.
The VCS command option %s is incompatible with UPF.
Remove the option %s and recompile.
UPF_INIT
UPF parser error
UPF parser could not be initialized because of error '%s'.

UPF_INPDB
Instance is not a power domain boundary
Design attribute 'terminal_boundary' specified on '%s' is invalid as the design instance is
not a power domain boundary or there are no matching power domains corresponding to
this design instance.
UPF_INSTANCE_NOT_FOUND
Instance not found in the UPF design.
Instance '%s' specified in '%s' UPF package API is not found.
Specify a valid instance name.
UPF_INSTANCE_NULL_STRING
Source is null
Source is passed as a null string in '%s' UPF package API.
Specify a valid instance name.

UPF_INTCSW
Invalid net type for control port of switch
'%s' used in net name of control port '%s' is not a valid type for the power switch '%s'.
Specify a net with valid type for control port, ex:logic.
UPF_INV_ATTR_VAL
Invalid Attribute value specified
Invalid Attribute value '%s' specified for attribute '%s' in command '%s'. Attribute will be
Specify one of the following values : '%s'.
UPF_INV_LDB
Invalid use of lower_domain_boundary
Setting %s at scope '%s' is not allowed %s. %s.

UPF_INV_LDBF
Invalid use of lower_domain_boundary
Setting the value of design attribute 'lower_domain_boundary' to 'FALSE' for block '%s' is
not allowed as there is no domain scoped at that level.
Attribute value can be set to 'FALSE' only if the block is the extent of a domain scoped at
that block.
UPF_INV_LDBT
Invalid use of lower_domain_boundary
Setting the value of design attribute 'lower_domain_boundary' to 'TRUE' for block '%s' is

evel.
Attribute value can be set to 'FALSE' only if the block is the extent of a domain scoped at
that block.

Invalid use of lower_domain_boundary
Setting the value of design attribute 'lower_domain_boundary' to 'TRUE' for block '%s' is
not allowed as the attribute value for the parent of the block is set to 'FALSE'.
Attribute value for a block can be set to 'TRUE' only if none of its parent blocks have the
value set to 'FALSE'.
UPF_INV_SIM_BEH
Invalid UPF Simstate Behavior specified

Invalid value '%s' has been provided for the UPF simstate behavior.
Valid values are ENABLE|DISABLE.
UPF_INV_VCT
VCT does not exist.
Value Conversion Table (VCT) '%s' specified with the command '%s' is not present.
Either default VCTs or VCTs specified with create_*_ command are supported.
UPF_INV_VCT_HDL_STATE
Invalid HDL State is given
'%s' is not a valid HDL state.
The HDL state used with the '-table' option of create_*_vct is not valid.
UPF_INV_VCT_HDL_TYPE
Incorrect HDL type is specified.

'%s' is used with -hdl_type option of create_*_vct.
Valid HDL types with -hdl_type option are 'sv' and 'vhdl'.
UPF_INV_VCT_STATE_VALUE
Incorrect VCT Table has been specified.
State and Value both should be mentioned in the VCT table.
For %s %s no mapping %s is mentioned.
UPF_INV_VCT_SUPPLY_STATE
Invalid UPF Supply State is specified
%s is not a correct UPF supply state.
The UPF Supply State used with the '-table' option of create_*_vct is not valid.

UPF_INV_VCT_TABLE
Incorrect VCT Table has been defined.
1:n mapping should be there in the vct table.
'%s' state is used more than once on the left hand side of the table.
UPF_INVALID_ELAB_ONLY_SIM
Invalid elab only simulation
Design compiled with elaboration only mode cannot be used for simulation.
Remove elaboration only options to run simulation.
UPF_IOPBB
Policy on Power BlackBox
%s policy '%s' with location '%s' is specified on the Power Domain '%s' created in the
scope of Power BlackBox (Instance: %s, Module: %s).

Consider specifying the policy with location 'parent' or moving the policy inside the
BlackBox scope.
UPF_IOPTP
Policy on the parent of power top
%s policy '%s' of power domain '%s' is specified on power top instance '%s'. %s policy
with location '%s' cannot be specified on the %s of power top instance.
Consider specifying the policy with location 'self'.
UPF_IPMS
Illegal port map specified
Net name '%s' tied to '%s' using the '-ports' option of '%s' command is not used in the
'%s' commands to define isolation strategy '%s'.
Only supply/logic nets specified in the corresponding 'set_isolation/
set_isolation_control' UPF command must be used along with the '-ports' option.
UPF_IRTDA
Invalid runtime design attribute

Invalid attribute '%s' specified with '%s' command in runtime power config file.
Verify if it is a compile time attribute and specify it in UPF file.
UPF_IS
Invalid scope in UPF
Scope '%s' %s does not exist in the design.%s
Provide a valid scope in UPF command and recompile.
UPF_IS_PTOP
Invalid scope in UPF
Scope '%s' specified with '%s' command is not in hierarchy under power top '%s'.
Valid scope in UPF can be either the power top.

UPF_ISC
Incorrect syntax for correlation
Value of design attribute 'correlated_supply_group' is expected to have curly braces to
separate the different correlated supply groups.
UPF_ISFC
Insufficient supplies for correlation
Value of design attribute 'correlated_supply_group' is expected to have at-least '2'
supply net names per 'supply_group'.
UPF_ISFTB
Invalid scope for terminal boundary
Design attribute 'terminal_boundary' cannot be specified on design instance '%s' as the
corresponding power domain '%s' is scoped at a different hierarchy '%s'. Power Domain
Definition:'%s,%s'
Power domain must be scoped at the same hierarchy that is being marked as terminal
boundary.

UPF_ISGRP
Invalid group specified
Group specified '%s' in the '-group' option of the 'add_power_state' command does not
exist in the scope.
Specify from predefined/user-defined group.
UPF_ISO_LNS
Location not supported.
The given location 'Sibling' of Isolation policy is not supported.
Specify one of 'self/parent/fanout/automatic' as location.
UPF_ISO_MULTIPLE_STRATEGY_PORT
Multiple isolation rules or strategies on same port.

Multiple isolation rules or strategies on same port. Isolation strategies '%s' and '%s' are
applied to the same design port '%s'%s. Specifying multiple isolation strategies with the
same precedence on the same port is not allowed.
Change the '-source/-sink/-diff_supply_only/-no_isolation' on one of the
strategies or remove the port from one of the strategies.
UPF_ISO_PGNS
Power and Ground Supplies Not Specified
Both Power and Ground supplies have not been specified for Isolation Policy '%s'.
At least one of -isolation_power_net or -isolation_ground_net options must be
specified for the command set_isolation.
UPF_ISPSRS
Invalid single pin save restore sense
Save/Restore signal '%s' for single pin retention strategy '%s' is specified with same active
level/edge '%s'.
Specify different active level/edge for save and restore signal in case of single pin
retention strategy.

UPF_ISPSS
Invalid simstate specified
Simstate '%s' specified for power state '%s' is invalid. Only simstate 'CORRUPT' is allowed
when the supply expression uses 'OFF' supply state for supply function '%s'.
UPF_ISS
Invalid scope specified
Scope '%s' specified for '%s' command is %s.
Only module instances should be specified for '%s' command.
UPF_ISSLE
Isolation signal/supply limit exceeded
Number of signals '%s' specified with '-isolation_signal' for the isolation strategy '%s'
exceeds the maximum allowed number '%s'.
Specify the appropriate number of isolation signals and recompile.

UPF_ISUSS
Invalid simstate update on Supply Set
'-simstate' is mandatory with '-update', since default simstate of the Supply Set '%s' has
already been set to '%s'.

Invalid timeunit specification
Time unit for UPF object '%s' can be either of 's|ms|us|ns|ps|fs'.
Specify a valid time unit using command '%s' in the UPF file during compile time.
UPF_IUESC
Invalid UPF expression syntax
A syntax error occurred in the expression specified for '%s', provide correct syntax.

UPF_IUESPA
Invalid enable_state_propagation_in_add_power_state value
Value of attribute 'enable_state_propagation_in_add_power_state' is set to '%s' for
block '%s' and to '%s' for its parent '%s'.
All descendants of a block with this attribute 'TRUE' must also have value 'TRUE'.
UPF_IUO
Invalid UPF object
%s '%s' specified with '%s' is not defined in scope %s.
Specify a valid %s and recompile.
UPF_IUPSS
Illegal update on power state simstate
Trying to update '-simstate' of power state '%s' of Supply Set '%s 'in the
'add_power_state' command from '%s' to '%s'.

UPF_IUTBA
Invalid use of terminal boundary attribute
Design attribute 'terminal_boundary' specified on '%s' is invalid as the design instance
has isolation strategy '%s' specified with '%s' on its power domain '%s'. Power Domain:%s,
%s Isolation Strategy:%s,%s.
UPF_IVVSP
Invalid Voltage Values for Supply Port
%s voltage value '%s' cannot be greater than %s voltage Value '%s' in command '%s'.
UPF_LDB_ISPD
Incorrect Scoping of Power Domain
Value of attribute 'lower_domain_boundary' is set to 'FALSE' for block '%s' and to 'TRUE'
for its parent (%s, %s). Domains of all descendant blocks of '%s' must be scoped at or
below it. Power Domain '%s' is incorrectly scoped at '%s' with the descendant block '%s'
as its element.
Ensure that power domain is scoped properly and recompile.

UPF_LFNS_LDB
Location fanout not supported
Isolation strategy '%s' is specified with location 'fanout'. Location 'fanout' is not supported
when the 'lower_domain_boundary' feature is enabled on any part of the design.
UPF_LIST_LEN
Improper number of arguments
UPF command option '%s' is expected to have '%s' arguments, but has '%s' argument(s).
Pass the appropriate number of arguments and recompile.
UPF_LNMD
Logic net has multiple drivers
Logic net '%s' is multiply driven by below ports.\n %s.
Ensure that the logic net is not multiply driven and recompile.

UPF_LNNF
Logic net not found
Logic net '%s' specified with command 'connect_logic_net' is not found in the UPF
scope '%s'.
Specify an existing logic net and also ensure that the logic net name specified is a simple
name.
UPF_LOAD
UPF parser not loaded
UPF parser '%s' could not be loaded because of error '%s'.
UPF_LOAOS
Loop of associations of Supply Sets
The association of handle '%s' to supply set handle/reference '%s' forms a loop of
associations.

Ensure that the root of the handle is not the same as the root.
UPF_LOGIC_CONNECTION_NS_VHDL_HIERARCHY
Command 'connect_logic_net' has port through VHDL hierarchy
Command 'connect_logic_net' is not supported through VHDL hierarchy. Logic net '%s'
will not be connected to Logic port '%s'.
UPF_LOGIC_CONNECTION_NS_VHDL_SCOPE
Command 'connect_logic_net' not supported in Vhdl Scope
Command 'connect_logic_net' is only supported in SystemVerilog scope. Logic net '%s'
will not be connected to Logic port '%s'.
UPF_LOGIC_NET_NS_VHDL_SCOPE
Command 'create_logic_net' not supported in Vhdl Scope
Command 'create_logic_net' is only supported in SystemVerilog scope. Logic net '%s'
will not be created in VHDL scope '%s'.

UPF_LOGIC_PORT_NS_VHDL_SCOPE
Command 'create_logic_port' not supported in Vhdl Scope
Command 'create_logic_port' is only supported in SystemVerilog scope. Logic port '%s'
will not be created in VHDL scope '%s'.
UPF_LPNA_LDB
Location parent not allowed
Isolation strategy '%s' is specified with location 'parent'. Value of
'lower_domain_boundary' attribute is %s for scope '%s.'
Location 'parent' is not allowed for scopes where the 'lower_domain_boundary' attribute
is set to TRUE or the attribute value is changed to FALSE.
UPF_LUINFO
Incorrect use of option -leaf_only/-non_leaf in find_objects
Option '-leaf_only/-non_leaf' cannot be specified for object_type net/port in
find_objects.

UPF_MACRO_NYI
NYI upf_simstate found inside macro.
Module '%s' is instantiated inside macro '%s' has upf_simstate already in it, thus it can't
be further instrumented.
Remove the aforesaid macro from power config file.
UPF_MACRO_NYI_PC
Macro perf mode is unsupported in Partcomp/PrecompiledIP.
Remove the option '%s' from command line.
UPF_MCSGS
Multiple Correlated Supply Groups
Multiple correlated supply groups cannot be defined at the same scope.
Correlated supply groups were already specified at scope '%s' using design attribute
'%s'(%s,%s).

UPF_MIE
Missing isolation enable
Mapped Isolation strategy '%s' does not have a corresponding isolation enable defined for
it in port map but isolation strategy has an isolation control '%s'.
Specify isolation enable for the above mapped isolation strategy in UPF.
UPF_MIRROR_STATE_DRIVER_CHECK
Unexpected Driver Found
The second argument: %s passed to the system task: $upf_mirror_state() has
unexpected driver at file name: %s, line number: %s.
The second argument to the $upf_mirror_state is not expected to have any driver, the
system task call drives the variable.
UPF_MIRROR_STATE_TYPE_ERR
Incorrect argument to $upf_mirror_state

The second argument: %s passed to the system task: $upf_mirror_state() is incorrect.
Expected only UPF::supply_net_type variable.
The usage is: $upf_mirror_state(supply_net/Supply_pad_name-as-string, local-
variable-of-type-upf::supply_net_type).

Hdl type is mismatch.
'sv' is used with the -hdl_type option of create_*_vct.
The table is defined for vhdl states, but -hdl_type is sv.

Incorrect splitting of module.

Module %s has been split into following instances %s. This is not correct, few instances
have retention signature mismatch which require more splitting of modules.

Mandatory option missing
The mandatory option '%s' is missing from the '%s' command.
Provide the missing option and recompile.
UPF_MOPM
Mandatory option missing
The mandatory option '%s' is missing from the '%s' command defined for isolation strategy
Provide the missing option and recompile.
UPF_MPTS
Multiple power top specified

Multiple power tops have been specified with '-power_top %s' on VCS command line and
'set_design_top %s' in UPF.
Only one power top must be specified.
UPF_MSSET_SET
Master Supply Set already set
Master Supply Set for Supply Set Handle '%s' is already set to '%s'. Supply Set
association with '%s' will be ignored.
Verify the association of Supply Set Handle.
UPF_MST_SET
Master Supply Net already set
Master Supply Net for Supply Net Handle '%s' is already set to '%s'. Supply Net
association with '%s' will be ignored

Verify the association of Supply Net Handle.
UPF_MSU
Multiple Scopes Unsupported
Only one scope must be specified with the '-elements' option for design attribute '%s'.
Correct the 'set_design_attributes' command in UPF and recompile.
UPF_MTS
Multiple timescale specified
Multiple timescale specified for power switch '%s'.
At most one time unit should be specified for one power switch.
UPF_MULT_DRV
Multiple driver cannot be added

Unresolved Supply Net '%s' is multiply driven by Supply Ports '%s' and '%s'. Resolution
must be specified for multiply driven supply nets.
Specify appropriate resolution using the '-resolve' option with 'create_supply_net' for
the supply net.
UPF_MULT_DRV_IMPLICIT
Multiple drivers cannot be added
Unresolved Supply Net '%s' is already driven by Supply Port '%s'.
Supply Port '%s' cannot be added as a driver.
UPF_MULT_DRV_SOURCE
Multiple drivers cannot be added
Unresolved Supply Net '%s' is multiply driven by '%s' and '%s'. Resolution must be
parallel/one_hot for multiply driven supply nets.
Specify appropriate resolution using the '-resolve' option with 'create_supply_net' for
the supply net.

UPF_MVDBDIR_NS
No liberty compilation directory specified
Specify valid liberty db compilation directory with -mvdbdir.
UPF_NPSSS
No Power State on Supply Set
Supply Set '%s' does not have any power state specified.
Use the 'add_power_state' command to add a power state to the Supply Set.
UPF_NT_CSN
Unsupported Nettype Object with CSN
Element '%s' (%s,%s) specified in the UPF file is of type 'SV nettype with non-real base
type'.

UPF_NT_OBJ
Unsupported Net Type Object
Element '%s' (%s,%s) specified in the UPF file is of type SV 'nettype'. Reference
to SV 'nettype' in UPF other than real nettype with 'connect_supply_net'/
'set_related_supply_net'/ 'set_port_attributes' command is not supported.
Modify the UPF file accordingly and recompile.

NOT_NORMAL updated to NORMAL simstate
Trying to update default '-simstate' of Supply Set '%s' in 'add_power_state' command
from '%s' to '%s'.

No valid elements found

If part-selects are specified, replace them with bit-blasted elements.
UPF_NVEFDB
No valid elements found
Isolation strategy '%s' does not have any valid elements in the '-elements' list.

title: Verification Continuum™
text:
The Retention %s has an element %s which is referred by another retention policy earlier.
This can happen if set_retention -elements {%s} is written for two different retention
policies.
UPF_RMNYI
Attribute ret_mode not yet implemented in partcomp flow
Attribute 'ret_mode' specified in the 'set_design_attribute' command is not
implemented in the partition comp flow.
Either use single compile flow or remove 'set_design_attribute' from UPF.
UPF_RPPDM
RTL PG Port Direction Mismatch
Direction '%s' of RTL PG port '%s' specified in UPF does not match with the direction '%s'
specified in the design.
Ensure direction of RTL PG ports are same in design and UPF.
UPF_RSLV_DONT_MATCH
Inconsistent -resolve value specified

title: Verification Continuum™
text:
Inconsistent -resolve value '%s' specified for UPF Supply Net '%s' that has resolve value
'%s' specified in earlier declaration at line '%s' of file '%s'.
Specify only one resolution type for a supply net.
UPF_RTLPG_DNP
Different RTL PG Net and Port Connected
RTL PG Supply Net '%s' is connected to RTL PG Supply Port '%s' in same scope. RTL PG
supply net can only be connected to same name RTL PG supply port in same scope.
Specify only same name RTL PG supply port in 'connect_supply_net' for the same
scope.
UPF_RTLPG_MPC
Multiple ports connected to RTL PG Net
RTL PG Supply Net '%s' is connected to multiple ports in same scope. RTL PG supply net
can only be connected to an RTL PG supply port in same scope.

Specify only one RTL PG supply port in 'connect_supply_net' for the same scope.
UPF_RTLPG_NRP
Non RTL PG Port in same scope
RTL PG Supply Net '%s' is connected to a non RTL PG Supply Port '%s' in same scope.
RTL PG supply net can only be connected to an RTL PG supply port in same scope.
Specify only RTL PG supply port in 'connect_supply_net' for same scope.
UPF_RTLPG_USP
Unconnected RTL PG Port
RTL PG Supply Port '%s' does not have a RTL PG Supply Net connected to in its scope.
Remove 'create_supply_port' command for this port.
UPF_RUOUSN
'-reuse' used on undefined Supply Net

In the 'create_supply_net' command, '-reuse' is specified, but Supply net '%s' is not
defined in either UPF or the design.
Ensure that the supply net is already defined when using '-reuse'.
UPF_SAC_CTRL_EXPR_NON_USER_OBJECT
Control expression contains unsupported object
The option -control_expr contains internal UPF object: %s.
UPF_SAC_CTRL_EXPR_NON_VERILOG_OBJECT
Control expression contains unsupported object type.
A non-Verilog object %s referred in the -control_expr option of command
'sim_assertion_control'. Only Verilog signals are supported in control_expr.
UPF_SDA_CNS
Command not supported

Command '%s' is not supported inside scope '%s' with attribute %s '%s'.
Set the attribute value for scope '%s' to '%s' using command '%s'.
UPF_SDA_CV
Conflicting ret_mode values
%s '%s' has ret_mode specified as both RET_ACCURATE and RET_PESSIMISTIC.
Remove conflicting ret_mode definitions from UPF file to avoid this error.
UPF_SDA_INVALID_VAL
Invalid change of attribute value
Attribute value cannot be changed for '%s', as this scope already has supply set states.
Attribute enable_state_propagation_in_add_power_state can only be applied to
scope before specification of supply set states.
UPF_SDA_WM
Attribute without -models

Attribute '%s' specified without mandatory option '-models' in 'set_design_attributes'
Specify valid command and recompile.
UPF_SEUPF
Syntax error in UPF
There is a Tcl syntax or semantic error in UPF. %s.
Fix according to normal Tcl/UPF syntax.
UPF_SNUBPG
Supply Net used as both power/ground
Supply Net '%s' is used as %s and a connected Supply Net '%s' has been used as '%s'.

A supply net can either be a power or ground. Some of the possible ways to mark
a net as power ground are by using the commands 'set_domain_supply_net/
create_supply_net/set_related_supply_net'.
UPF_SPA_RONF
Required option not found
Option '%s' is required for port attribute '%s'.
Attribute '%s' can only be used with '%s' option.
UPF_SPDNE
Supply Port/Net does not exist
Supply Port/Net '%s' used in the '-elements' option of 'set_design_attributes'
command does not exist.
UPF_SPDNTE
Supply Port does not exist

Supply port '%s' specified with '%s' does not exist.
Provide a valid supply port and recompile.
UPF_SPNF
Supply Port not found
'%s' %s could not be resolved to any valid design or UPF element.%s
Specify a valid supply port and recompile.
UPF_SS_DEF
Supply Set already defined
Supply Set '%s' has already been defined at %s, %s.
Use '-update' to update an existing Supply Set. To create a new Supply Set, change the
name of Supply Set.
UPF_SS_NOTS
Simstate not specified

State '%s' specified in transition object '%s' is not a simstate.
Specify a state from NORMAL, CORRUPT, CORRUPT_ON_ACTIVITY,
CORRUPT_ON_CHANGE, CORRUPT_STATE_ON_ACIVITY,
CORRUPT_STATE_ON_CHANGE.
UPF_SS_UPDATE_ND
Supply Set not defined but -update used
Supply Set '%s' has not been defined, but 'create_supply_set -update' has been used.
To create a new Supply Set, remove '-update'.
UPF_SSB_CV
Conflicting set_simstate_behavior values
%s '%s' has simstate behavior specified as both DISABLE and ENABLE.

Remove conflicting set_simstate_behavior definitions from the UPF file to avoid this
error.
UPF_SSF_DEFINED
Supply Net for function already defined
Supply Set Function '%s' already has a Supply Net '%s'
Update the function to the same net as before or do not associate the function with a net.
UPF_SSNRSD
Supply Source has no root supply driver
Supply Source with id '%s' has no root supply driver.
UPF_SSS
Simstate cannot be specified
State '%s' specified in transition object '%s' is a simstate.

Do not use a simstate as other states specified in the transition are not simstates.
UPF_SSSAS
Supply Set simstate already set
Default '-simstate' of Supply Set '%s' in the 'add_power_state' command has already
been set to '%s'. Trying to set default simstate to '%s'.
UPF_SSUIS
Supply Set updated to invalid simstate
Trying to update default '-simstate' of Supply Set '%s' in the 'add_power_state'
command to '%s'. Default simstate already set to '%s'.
UPF_SYMBOL_EXISTS
Symbol already exists in scope
Symbol '%s' of type '%s' already exists in scope '%s'. Symbol names must be unique in a
given scope.

Specify unique name for symbols and recompile.
UPF_UCO
Unsupported command option
'%s' for '%s' is not supported in MVSIM-NATIVE.
Define a separate %s with combination of %s options.
UPF_UDE
Unsupported design element
Design element '%s' specified for power domain '%s' is not an instance.
Only design instances are supported with the '-elements' option of the
'create_power_domain -simulation_only' command.
UPF_UDLP
Undefined Logic Port

title: Verification Continuum™
text:
Unsupported design element
Design element '%s' specified for power domain '%s' is not an instance.
Only design instances are supported with the '-elements' option of the
'create_power_domain -simulation_only' command.
UPF_UDLP
Undefined Logic Port

Logic port '%s' specified with '%s' is not defined.
Ensure that the logic port is defined before being used.
UPF_UEFC
Unsupported element list for correlation
Only '.' is supported as element list with the '-elements' option for design attribute '%s'.
Correct the 'set_design_attributes' command and recompile.
UPF_UETS
Unsupported element type specified
Unsupported type of element encountered in query command.
UPF_UISOS
Undefined Isolation strategy

Isolation strategy '%s' for the domain '%s' specified with UPF command '%s' is not defined.
Ensure that the isolation strategy is defined for that domain before being used.
UPF_UKSAV
UPF keyword specified as value
UPF keyword '%s' used as value in '%s' option of '%s' command.
UPF_ULN
Undefined Logic Net
Logic net '%s' specified with '%s' is not defined.
Ensure that the logic net is defined before being used.
UPF_ULNR
UPF logic net re-declaration

Logic net '%s' re-declared within same domain.
UPF_ULPR
UPF logic port re-declaration
Logic port '%s' re-declared within same domain.
UPF_UNRESOLVED_TOP
UPF design top could not be resolved
%s specified as power top using 'set_design_top' could not be resolved.
UPF_UNS_ATTR_VAL
Unsupported Attribute value specified
Unsupported Attribute value '%s' specified for attribute '%s' in command '%s'. Supported
value is : '%s'.
Specify valid command and recompile.

UPF_UNSUP_DRIVER
Unsupported driver to reused Supply Net
HDL Supply Net '%s' is reused in UPF. Adding a driver '%s' to a reused Supply Net with
'connect_supply_net' is not supported.
The reused Supply Net implicitly tracks the value of the HDL Supply. Remove the driver to
the reused Supply Net in UPF.
UPF_UPC
Unsupported Port in Command
Port '%s' is not yet supported in '%s' command.
UPF_UPSWS
Undefined Power Switch strategy
Power Switch strategy '%s' for the domain '%s' specified with UPF command '%s' is not
defined.

Ensure that the Power Switch strategy is defined for that domain before being used.
UPF_URETS
Undefined Retention strategy
Retention strategy '%s' for the domain '%s' specified with UPF command '%s' is not
defined.
Ensure that the Retention strategy is defined for that domain before being used.
UPF_USDU
Unsupported target design unit specified
The target design unit '%s' is not a Verilog/VHDL unit.
Vera/SV/OVA programs cannot be specified as target design units in UPF.
UPF_USF_QMX
Unsupported query command in MX

The command '%s' is not yet supported for MX designs. The cell name '%s' passed to this
command is not a Verilog module
Use a Verilog module name with this query command.
UPF_USS
Undefined Supply Set
Supply set '%s' specified with '%s' is not defined.
Ensure that the supply set is defined before being used.
UPF_UUUS
'-update' used on undefined strategy
%s strategy '%s' has not been defined, but '%s -update' has been used.
To create a new strategy, remove '-update'.

Incompatible option

MDA size mismatch

size in the base design. It's size is %s in input test and %s in base design. This is defined
in the instance '%s'. Skipping this array while merging. This could happen if you are trying
to merge two test data generated from two different designs.
Ensure that the size of this array is same across different tests.

Use dve/urg to exclude this metric.

SC-VCS-NO-DLP
No DLP with SystemC in deltasync
Design Level Parallelism for a design containing SystemC is not supported when the
simulator is run in delta-sync mode.
Elaborate the design with -sysc=blocksync instead.
SC-VCS-NO-DLP-DONUT
No DLP with a SystemC donut design
Design topologies that contain a donut with SystemC are not supported to run with Design
Level Parallelism (DLP)
Elaborate without the DLP switches to simulate the donut design.

SC-VCS-NO-DLP-V
SystemC/DLP restriction
Design Level Parallelism of a design containing SystemC and Verilog, but no VHDL, is not
supported with SystemC running in blocksync mode.
Remove the switch -sysc=blocksync from the VCS command line and elaborate again.
SC-VCS-NO-FGP-BS
No FGP with SystemC in blocksync
Fine Grain Parallelism for a design containing SystemC is not supported when the
simulator is run in the block-sync mode.
Elaborate the design with -sysc=deltasync (default) instead.
SC-VCS-NO-MX-TOP
No VHDL, SystemC multi-top design
Multi-top designs with SystemC and VHDL as one of the tops is not allowed.

UCLI-152
No 'save' inside C domain
Command save is not supported while the simulation is stopped inside C, C++ or
SystemC code. The save command is possible again after the simulation leaves the C
domain and stops inside the Verilog or VHDL domain.
Advance the simulation until it leaves the C domain and then do a 'save' again. Use
commands such as next -end, cbug -detach, or run 1ps to exit the C domain.
If the simulation stops at a breakpoint within the C domain, run the command again until
you leave the C domain. To confirm your current location, enter puts $ucliCore::state.
Make sure that the result is not cbug or cbugtool.

save command again.

MSGLOG-SYSC-RELOCATED
Relocated msglog record
SystemC failed to determine the active scope of a msglog object. This can occur if the
object is used outside any SystemC scope, or if the parent thread or method has ended.
The msglog object is moved to the scope '%s' to prevent data loss. This warning appears
only once.
To debug the issue, use CBug to set a breakpoint in the cbug_msglog_stop_here
function. Set the breakpoint with the following UCLI commands: \n cbug\n stop -in
cbug_msglog_stop_here\n
The simulation stops each time the scope cannot be determined.

SC-EXCEPTION-CTOR
Uncaught C++ exception in SC_CTOR
A C++ exception was thrown but not caught while the constructor of SystemC module
instance '%s' was called. The simulation terminates soon.
Debugging with DVE/UCLI/CBug is not possible. However, you can debug the error with
gdb: \n $VCS_HOME/<arch>/bin/cbug-gdb-64/bin/gdb simv\n. Enter the following
commands in gdb: \n directory ${VCS_HOME}/etc/cbug\n break cbug_stop_here\n
catch throw\n run\n and then, use the continue commands until you reach the place
where the C++ exception is thrown but not caught.

VCS SystemC is looking for a hook named '%s' within the SystemC kernel, but it has
instead found an older, obsolete hook named '%s'.
If you are using the SYSTEMC_OVERRIDE flow, build a new SystemC installation based on
the hooks in the $VCS_HOME/etc/systemc-2.2 directory. If you are not using this flow,
contact VCS support.
SC-IGNORED-OPT
SystemC options ignored
The runtime option '%s' has been used. All the subsequent -sysc=options have been
ignored: %s
Check the runtime options.
SC-KERNEL-ERR-CTOR
SystemC kernel error in SC_CTOR
An error from the SystemC kernel occurred while the constructor of SystemC module
instance '%s' was called. The simulation terminates now.

title: Verification Continuum™
text:
Refer to the SystemC LRM to understand why the error occurred. Debugging with
DVE, UCLI, or CBug is not possible; however, you can debug the error using gdb, \n
$VCS_HOME/<arch>/bin/cbug-gdb-64/bin/gdb simv\n. Then, enter the following
commands in gdb: \n directory ${VCS_HOME}/etc/cbug\n break cbug_stop_here\n
catch throw\n run\n
SC-LATE-CONFIG
Config change after VPD open
The configuration value for '%s' changed while a VPD file is open.
This change may not be fully affective until the VPD file is re-opened.
SC-LOG-NEED-UCLI
Need UCLI for Msglog and Tblog
This pure SystemC simulation needs the UCLI infrastructure to support msglog and tblog.
Logging is disabled in this simulation run.
SC-MHPI-CTOR
SystemC access before initialization

During simulation initialization, a component requested an access to SystemC before
SystemC was initialized.
SC-MHPI-DTOR
Limited debug after SystemC is deleted
A UCLI command or MHPI function is called and tries to access a SystemC object.
However, some or all SystemC instances are already deleted. This can happen if the
sc_main() function has finished running. This message appears only once. After this,
UCLI or MHPI may not work properly.
Restart the simulation and execute the UCLI or MHPI command earlier.
SC-MHPI-LATE-CTOR
SystemC sc_module was created too late
The SC_MODULE instance '%s' was created after UCLI/MHPI/FSDB/VPD has already
traversed the instance hierarchy.

SC-MSGLOG-ARG-ORDER
Argument of Unexpected Type
In SystemC module '%s' [@ %s %s], argument number %s of msglog << is of
unexpected type.
Found '%s', expecting '%s'.
SC-PROF-PURESC
Profiling for pure SystemC not supported
The -simprofile option is not supported for designs that contain only SystemC but no
HDL modules.
SC-SCAN-NO-IO-DELAY
No delay types for inout ports
The delay type '%s' for the inout port '%s' is ignored because delays are not supported for
inout ports.

SC-SET-4
Value change delayed
SystemC port or signal '%s' is changed to the value '%s' using a UCLI change command.
The assignment is delayed until the next SystemC delta cycle. This message appears only
once during each simulation run. If you use the change command again to this or other
SystemC ports or signals, the message does not appear again,
For details about the restrictions when changing values in the C domain, refer to the 'Using
the C, C++, and SystemC Debugger' chapter of the UCLI User Guide.
SC-STACK-RANGE
Stack size range
The specified '%s' size value is %s
If you want to have another size, change the size value and restart the simulation.
SC-SYSCAN-CMP-UNSUP
Option -cmp not supported

The specified option '%s' is not supported with -tli_DA and is ignored.
Remove the unsupported option -cmp.
SC-SYSCAN-MDIR-EQ
Char '=' in -Mdir path
The path '%s' specified with the -Mdir option contains a '='. This causes failures in the
later compile steps. The path is therefore shortened to '%s' to prevent failures.
To prevent this warning, change the -Mdir path without '='.
SC-SYSCAN-SYSC-HNF
SystemC module header file not found
Cannot locate the header file '%s' with the module definition of '%s'.
It seems that the module name is different than the file name.
SC-SYSCAN-TLI-MULTIPLE-DECL
Multiple member declaration

Member variable '%s' is declared more than once in input class '%s'.
This might happen due to inheritance or name space.
SC-SYSCAN-TLM-NA
Ignoring explicit TLM directory
An explicit TLM directory '%s' was specified by either syscan -tlm2=<dir> or
by $TLM_OVERRIDE environment variable.
SC-TAPI-SKIPPED
TAPI is skipped
Advanced SystemC Type information based on Dwarf (TAPI) is not used because
environment variable '%s' has been set.
Dwarf information is not loaded now but may still be loaded later on.

SC-TIME-WHEEL-NOT-ZERO
SystemC time wheel not at time 0
The simulation is elaborated and is about to start. However, the time wheel in the SystemC
kernel is not at time zero but already at time %s. This is a severe problem and mights
occurred because sc_start() is called too early. For example inside a SystemC module
constructor, the SystemC time wheel is reset to time 0 in an attempt to correct this issue
but the simulation might still not work properly.
Change your SystemC source code and remove or postpone this illegal call to
sc_start(). To locate the statement, start the simulation from gdb and set a breakpoint
as follows:\n break sc_core::sc_start(sc_core::sc_time const&)\nor\n rbreak
sc_core::sc_start\n
Then run, locate the statement calling sc_start(), remove it, recompile, and check
whether this message disappears.
SC-TLI-ARRAY-BIG
Big array size for tlm_gp field.
The array size of %s for %s is large. This can result in performance issues and/or memory
limitations.
Check whether the size of the array is as been intended.

SC-TYPE-MAP
Invalid type mapping
The port '%s' in the portmap file uses an invalid floating point type mapping to '%s'.
The HDL type 'real' must be mapped to the C type 'double' and vice versa.
SC-UFE-2
KDB elaboration failed
The simulation contains SystemC and VCS tries to elaborate KDB but this failed. Dumping
the RIDB file and KDB elaboration is postponed until the first time when the design is
loaded into Verdi.
Use the -syscelab <arg> option to specify runtime arguments required by sc_main().
Use the VCS option, -kdb=noelab, to disable any attempt elaborating KDB during VCS
SC-UNCAUGHT-CPP-EXCEPTION
Uncaught C++ exception

A C++ exception of unknown type was thrown but not caught.
The simulation most likely terminates soon with a stack trace.
SC-UNKNOWN-ARG
Unknown SystemC option
The SystemC option '%s' is not known and is ignored.
Remove the option to avoid this warning.
SC-USER-SC-START
No simulation control in a HDL top design
It is not possible to control the simulation in a HDL top design through sc_start option..
The simulator is instead controlled by Verilog and/or VHDL statements.
SC-VCS-BINUTILS
Unsupported Binutils version

Binutils %s is currently used.

Analyze option ignored

Ignoring the analysis option '%s' during elaboration.
This option can only be used during the analysis phase while generating an interface from/

SC-VCS-INOUT-NSYNC
Inout ports need opt_if + deltasync
The design has SystemC-top topology and is elaborated with the -sysc=deltasync
option. This combination requires that all SC or HDL interface models containing inout
ports are analyzed with the -sysc=opt_if option. However, at least one SC or HDL
interface is analyzed without the -sysc=opt_if option. The simulation might not work
correctly.
Remove the entire csrc directory and analyze all SC or HDL interface models again
with the -sysc=opt_if option. For example, \n vlogan -sysc=opt_if my_file1.v
-sc_model my_model1\n vhdlan -sysc=opt_if my_file2.vhd -sc_model
my_model2\n
Then, elaborate again.
SC-VCS-LIBNE
Specified library doesn't exist
The library '%s' specified with VCS option '%s' does not exist and is skipped for any
dependency checking.

SC-VCS-OCOMP-WARN
Unsupported compiler
The compiler '%s %s' is not supported for VCS and SystemC. Using an unsupported
compiler can lead to odd behaviors or to unexpected crashes.
It is strongly recommended to use a supported compiler: %s.
SC-VCS-PARTCOMP-SKELETON
Part Comp requires skeleton
Partition Compile requires skeleton flow for SystemC-on-top topologies. Option
-sysc=noskeleton is ignored.
SC-VCS-PROF-PURESC
Profiling for pure SystemC not supported
The -simprofile option is not supported for designs that contain only SystemC but no
HDL modules.

Elaborate again without any -simprofile option.
SC-VCS-SDF-UNIHIER
SDF Limitation with SystemC-on-Top
Using sdf annotations for a SystemC-on-top design has limitations in finding the correct
hierarchical instances. It can happen that several attempts are made for finding it.
Use the -sysc=unihier option during elaboration, which defines the name of the top-
module of the design hierarchy as the given OSCI name in the design.
SC-VCS-SYSC-LINK
SystemC link issue
The %s executable has been linked with OSCI/Accellera SystemC. This might lead to a
crash or to an unpredictable behavior at simulation runtime.
Check the compilation script and make sure that no file is compiled using OSCI/Accellera
SystemC.
SC-VCS-SYSC-LINK-LIB
SystemC link issue

The library %s used by the %s executable has been linked with OSCI/Accellera SystemC.
This might lead to a crash or to an unpredictable behavior at simulation runtime.
Check the compilation script and make sure that no library is compiled using OSCI/
Accellera SystemC.
SC-VCS-SYSC-MLIB
Specified Mlib directory does not exist
The directory '%s' specified with the -Mlib option does not exist. Ignoring this directory.
Correct the path name and re elaborate again.
SC-VCS-SYSC-NOT-INST
SystemC module not instantiated from HDL
The SystemC module '%s' has been compiled with 'syscan <filename>:%s', but it is not
instantiated from the HDL part of the design.

Remove the ':%s' option from the syscan call in to speed-up the compilation.
SC-VCS-TOP-TOP
More than one -top option used
Specifying a multi top design using the -top option multiple times is not supported.
Remove all the -top options and elaborate again from scratch.

Unsupported option
The option '%s' is ignored, since it is no longer needed. It will be removed in an upcoming
Remove the option from the compile script.

SystemC link issue

The %s executable has been linked twice with the SystemC library, both statically and
dynamically. This might lead to a crash or to an unpredictable behavior at simulation
runtime.
Check the vcs command line. Do not add the SystemC library explicitly. VCS adds it
automatically.

Profiling of VHDL-top SystemC-down not supported
Profiling a design with a VHDL on top and SystemC down topology is not supported.
Simprofile results are be incomplete and inaccurate.
SC-VP-NO-SIMPROFILE
No VCS profiling of SystemC possible
Profiling while running with Virtualizer/SNPS_VP is not possible, so ignoring the
-simprofile elaboration option .

Conflicting options for time resolution

The elaboration options -sysc=adjust_timeres and -sysc=use_hdl_timeres conflict
each other. Ignoring the -sysc=adjust_timeres option .
